# Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow

Intelligent permission orchestration for .NET MAUI. Named feature flows, pre-prompt rationales, denial cooldowns, and Settings handoff.

Repository: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-permission-flow
Catalog: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow

Registration: `UsePermissionFlow` — see README.md.

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I show a rationale before the OS permission dialog in MAUI?
- Permission cooldown / Don't ask again / open Settings
- Named feature permission flows (camera + photos)

## Do not use when

- A single Permissions.RequestAsync<T>() is enough
- You need a custom OS permission type this plugin does not map
